about: Bestow goes past a substitute and past Protect (Pokemon Central, Sostituto (bambola): it ignores the substitute from the sixth generation; Cediregalo: every protection but Crafty Shield; Bulbapedia and Showdown's gen-9 bestow the same), where the audit read it as stopped by both: its subscript asks for no substitute and its record has no protect flag. Nothing in New Gold learns the move, so the scenario teaches it: in the Violet Gym the player's Snorlax holds Leftovers and knows Bestow alone, Falkner's Hoothoot holds nothing and knows Substitute alone (set:, teach:). The Hoothoot, the faster, puts up its substitute and still receives the Leftovers; then, taught Protect alone and holding nothing again, it protects itself and still receives the Snorlax's Silk Scarf.
